# LowRouter

Use `lowrouter/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "lowrouter-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "lowrouter/auto/mistralai/codestral-2508",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `LOWROUTER_API_KEY`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://api.lowrouter.ai/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `LOWROUTER_BASE_URL`.

- https://lowrouter.ai/docs/models/available
